props.name: caption
props.description: Shown in the footer when no cell is active.

props.name: value
props.description: Id of the selected cell, `${row}:${column}`. Selected day key.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (((value: string | null) => void) & ((value: string | null) => void))

props.name: levels
props.description: Steps on the ramp, counting the empty level 0.

props.name: data
props.description: Totals per day, as a key map or a list; repeated days add up.

props.name: end
props.description: Last day shown. Defaults to today.

props.name: start
props.description: First day shown. Defaults to `weeks` back from `end`.

props.name: today
props.description: Day that gets the mark. Defaults to today; null for none.

props.name: unit
props.description: Singular noun for the readout: "3 commits on Sep 29, 2026".

props.name: onActiveChange
props.type: ((day: { date: string; value: number; } | null) => void)

examples.title: 26 weeks · monday start · round
examples.setup: const RUNS = definesActivityDays({ seed: 21, days: 26 * 7, busy: 0.5 })
examples.code:
<CalendarHeatmap
  data={RUNS}
  end={DEMO_ACTIVITY_END}
  today={DEMO_ACTIVITY_END}
  weeks={26}
  weekStartsOn={1}
  shape="round"
  size="lg"
  unit="run"
  color="oklch(0.65 0.2 25)"
  legend={false}
  aria-label="Runs by day"
/>

examples.title: a year of commits · today is marked
examples.code:
<CalendarHeatmap
  data={COMMITS}
  end={DEMO_ACTIVITY_END}
  today={DEMO_ACTIVITY_END}
  unit="commit"
  color="oklch(0.66 0.17 150)"
  value={day}
  onValueChange={setDay}
  caption={day ? `Picked ${day}` : "Hover a day, or click to pick"}
  aria-label="Commits by day"
/>
